franchiseSite.title: Own a {brand} franchise
franchiseSite.intro: Tell us about yourself and where you would like to open. Our franchise development team will get back to you.
franchiseSite.name: Full name
franchiseSite.regionHint: For example CA, ON or NSW
franchiseSite.financialNote: Optional and self-declared. Nothing is checked or shared at this stage.
franchiseSite.message: Anything else you would like us to know?
franchiseSite.consent: I agree that {brand} may contact me about owning a franchise and keep these details for that purpose.
franchiseSite.marketing: Send me {brand} franchise news by email (optional)
franchiseSite.thanksBody: The {brand} franchise development team will contact you soon.
franchiseSite.errConsent: Agree so that we can contact you.
franchiseSite.linkInvalid: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask the franchisor for a new one.
franchiseSite.receiptIntro: {brand} has sent you its franchise disclosure document, {name}. Please read it carefully before you make any decision.
franchiseSite.reviewAdvice: Take the time you need, and review it with a lawyer and an accountant. You do not have to sign anything else now.
franchiseSite.acknowledge: I confirm that I received this document
franchiseSite.receiptNotAgreement: Signing this receipt only confirms that you received the document. It is not an agreement to buy a franchise.
franchiseSite.waitingNote: By law you have time to review it: you cannot be asked to sign a franchise agreement or pay before {date}.
franchiseSite.errReceipt: Type your full name and tick the box to confirm you received the document.
franchiseSite.signIntro: {brand} has sent you its franchise agreement, {name}. Read it in full before you sign.
franchiseSite.accept: I have read the agreement and agree to sign it electronically
franchiseSite.esignNote: We record your typed name, the time and your IP address as your electronic signature.
franchiseSite.coolingOff: You may cancel under the cooling-off rules until {date}.
franchiseSite.notAvailable: This agreement is no longer available to sign.
franchiseSite.canSignFrom: You can sign this agreement from {date}. The waiting period gives you time to review the disclosure document.
franchiseSite.cannotSignYet: This agreement cannot be signed yet. The franchisor will contact you.
franchiseSite.errSign: Type your full name and tick the box to sign.
franchiseSite.esignLegal: Electronic signatures are recognised in many countries, but rules differ. Ask your own lawyer if you have questions about signing electronically.
franchiseSite.mapIntro: {count, plural, =0 {No territory is open right now.} one {# territory is open for new franchisees.} other {# territories are open for new franchisees.}}
franchiseSite.noneAvailable: Every territory is taken right now. Send an enquiry and we'll tell you when one opens.
franchiseSite.validationIntro: Hi {name}, these {brand} franchise owners have offered to tell you what running a unit is really like. Book a short call with each of them.
franchiseSite.validationProposeHint: Suggest two or three times, with your time zone.
franchiseSite.validationProposed: You suggested: {times}. They will confirm by email.
franchiseSite.validationEmpty: Nobody is assigned yet. We'll email you when calls are set up.
franchiseSite.validationNote: These calls are between you and the franchisee. {brand} doesn't listen in.
